caption: The drawing consists of a rectangular section filled with an intricate and repetitive pattern made up primarily of red shapes on a cream or off-white background. The central area features stylized, symmetric botanical elements such as leaves and curving vines, along with multiple clusters of circular berry-like forms. The left edge contains a thick vertical band with a zigzag or stepped motif filled with leaf patterns, also in red. The top and left borders have small decorative motifs, while the right border includes a vertical row of red and white triangles alternating in direction and a band with a geometric square design at the bottom right corner. The overall pattern is constructed using closely set red hatching and dots to create the shapes, with fine details indicating variation in texture within the design. The entire patterned area is enclosed by a double-line border on the same cream or off-white background.
title: Homespun Coverlet
